why: The canary goes straight into a query this server must forward to api.github.com. No tool on this server has an empty 'required', so github admits no argument-less call.
Second canary carrier on a different parameter name (q, not query), so a match is not an artefact of one field.

A read with no canary, against a public repository, to separate 'reached api.github.com' from 'forwarded our argument'. Read-only on purpose: the 26 tools include create_repository, create_issue and merge_pull_request, which validate against their schemas and would act on a real third party. A witness that acts cannot attest to its own acts (docs/DOCTRINE.md, negativa 4).
